mapper.sql: id, user_id, template_id, template_title, template_cover_url, status, stage, error_stage, error_message, result_url, created_at, started_at, finished_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO creation_task (user_id, template_id, template_title, template_cover_url, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{templateId}, #{templateTitle}, #{templateCoverUrl}, #{status}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM creation_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING') ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id FROM creation_task WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE creation_task SET status = 'RUNNING', started_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE creation_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', stage = 'FINALIZING', result_url = #{resultUrl}, error_stage = NULL, error_message = NULL, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE creation_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_stage = #{stage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, error_message = #{message,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE creation_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_stage = stage, error_message = #{message}, finished_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
